An additional lawsuit supports the predicted pattern but does not establish that states had little effective alternative.

criteria.contradiction_condition: During a verified federal-policy gap, records show that states have effective, practicable preventive alternatives addressing the same harms, materially defeating the claimed dependence on reactive litigation.
